statement: Define next(xs), for a nonempty list xs, as the list consisting of xs[0] followed, in increasing order of original index, by exactly those xs[i] with 0 < i < len(xs) and xs[i-1] <= xs[i]. Define step^0(nums) = nums and step^{k+1}(nums) = next(step^k(nums)). The function returns a result r and r is the least nonnegative integer k such that step^k(nums) is non-decreasing, i.e. for every j with 0 < j < len(step^k(nums)), step^k(nums)[j-1] <= step^k(nums)[j].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and does not fail.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and 0 <= r <= len(nums) - 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0 if and only if nums is non-decreasing, i.e. for every i with 0 < i < len(nums), nums[i-1] <= nums[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Define next(xs), for a nonempty list xs, as the list consisting of xs[0] followed, in increasing order of original index, by exactly those xs[i] with 0 < i < len(xs) and xs[i-1] <= xs[i]. Define step^0(nums) = nums and step^{k+1}(nums) = next(step^k(nums)). Whenever total_steps(nums) returns r, for every integer k >= 0, step^{r+k}(nums) = step^r(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Define next(xs), for a nonempty list xs, as the list consisting of xs[0] followed, in increasing order of original index, by exactly those xs[i] with 0 < i < len(xs) and xs[i-1] <= xs[i]. Define step^0(nums) = nums and step^{k+1}(nums) = next(step^k(nums)). Whenever total_steps(nums) returns r, for every k with 1 <= k <= r, len(step^k(nums)) < len(step^{k-1}(nums)).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Define next(xs), for a nonempty list xs, as the list consisting of xs[0] followed, in increasing order of original index, by exactly those xs[i] with 0 < i < len(xs) and xs[i-1] <= xs[i]. Define step^0(nums) = nums and step^{k+1}(nums) = next(step^k(nums)). Whenever total_steps(nums) returns r, for every k with 0 <= k <= r, step^k(nums) is nonempty and step^k(nums)[0] = nums[0].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever total_steps(nums) returns r, for every list ys satisfying 1 <= len(ys) <= 100000, 1 <= ys[i] <= 1000000000 for all i with 0 <= i < len(ys), len(ys) = len(nums), and for all i,j with 0 <= i < len(nums) and 0 <= j < len(nums), nums[i] <= nums[j] if and only if ys[i] <= ys[j], if total_steps(ys) returns r', then r' = r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Define next(xs), for a nonempty list xs, as the list consisting of xs[0] followed, in increasing order of original index, by exactly those xs[i] with 0 < i < len(xs) and xs[i-1] <= xs[i]. Define step^0(nums) = nums and step^{k+1}(nums) = next(step^k(nums)). Whenever total_steps(nums) returns r, len(step^r(nums)) <= len(nums) - r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Define next and step as in spec_1. Whenever total_steps(nums) returns r, step^r(nums) is exactly the list, in increasing order of i, of those nums[i] with 0 <= i < len(nums) and for every j with 0 <= j < i, nums[j] <= nums[i]. Equivalently, after the process terminates the remaining elements are precisely the non-strict prefix maxima of nums.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.
